item.title: Confronting Childhood Cancer Easter 3K Run/Walk at Wickham Park Set April 4, Will Benefit Candlelighters of Brevard
item.description: Who wants to meet the Easter Bunny? The local nonprofit, Confronting Childhood Cancer, will hold its annual Easter 3K Walk/Run on Saturday, April 4, 2026, at Wickham Park, 2500 Parkway Drive, Melbourne, Florida, to benefit Candlelighters of Brevard. If you have not registered in advance, you may register on the morning of the run starting at 8 a.m. The race will begin at 9 a.m. at the Youth Pavillion.
